title: Export follows the Supply filter and leaves out an untracked part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active tracked part, part A, holding 1, with Min 5 and Max 10, so it is under-supplied.
  • Have an active untracked part, part B, with 1 in its bin and a saved Min 5 and Max 10.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Use a computer that can open the exported file in a spreadsheet program.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Pick Under-supplied in the Supply filter.
  3. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Export.
  5. Open the downloaded file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed.
  • Part B is not listed: an untracked part shows only under All.

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • A file downloads.

Step 5:

  • The file holds part A.
  • Part B is not in the file.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List), story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)

  • S6-R10: “In the Supply filter, an untracked part shows only under "All". Under-supplied, Well-supplied and Over-supplied leave it out.”
